create_openloop_gait_generator: create an OpenloopGaitGenerator instance with custom stance duration, duty factor, and trotting leg phase for a quadruped robot
update_gait_phase: call update on the OpenloopGaitGenerator to compute desired leg states and normalized phase for each leg at the current time
reset_gait_generator: reset the OpenloopGaitGenerator to initial leg states and zero normalized phase at a given time
review_leg_state_properties: review the desired_leg_state and leg_state properties to inspect SWING, STANCE, EARLY_CONTACT, or LOSE_CONTACT states for all legs
refactor_contact_detection: refactor the OpenloopGaitGenerator contact detection logic to adjust force and phase thresholds for early touchdown and lost contact scenarios
